This is a home for notes, essays, and ideas that do not belong in the main
technical blog.

The site is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) and its source is available
on [GitHub](https://github.com/ritog/thoughts). Each thought gets a short,
stable URL under `ritoghosh.com/thoughts/`.
